title: Delimitation
description: Fixing the boundaries of territorial constituencies to reflect changes in population.

title: Electoral Rolls Update
description: Preparation and revision of the electoral rolls to include new voters and remove ineligible ones.

title: Announcement & Notification
description: The Election Commission announces the schedule, and the President/Governor issues the formal notification.

title: Model Code of Conduct (MCC)
description: Comes into effect immediately after the announcement to ensure a level playing field.

title: Filing of Nominations
description: Candidates submit their nomination papers to the Returning Officer.

title: Scrutiny of Nominations
description: The Returning Officer checks the nomination papers for validity.

title: Withdrawal of Candidature
description: Candidates are given a few days to withdraw their nominations if they wish.

title: Campaigning
description: Candidates campaign to woo voters. Campaigning ends 48 hours before polling starts.

title: Polling Day
description: Voters cast their votes using Electronic Voting Machines (EVMs) and VVPATs.

title: Counting of Votes
description: Votes are counted under the supervision of the Returning Officer.

title: Declaration of Results
description: The candidate with the highest number of valid votes is declared elected.
